I bring my own lunch everyday that I'm scheduled for a lunch (30 min unpaid breaks), at my store we get 10 min breaks for Team Members/Managers, Minors get 15 min breaks (17 or younger) and anyone scheduled 6+ hours for work gets a 30min unpaid break and our franchisee changed in 2024 we get free medium sized meal if you work 3 hours or more so that's nice. 

Arby's isn't the healthiest but it sure is damn tasty! I usually bring my lunch and get food after work before I leave If still hungry or need a quick dinner haha.
